cb_sentinel_stingers.accept_append: Their matriarch is the big one in the deepest crevice. The herd will not come back while she is there.

cb_weeping_pilgrim.accept_append: The other drowned pilgrims walk with her. You will have to put them down to reach her.

cb_echo_of_the_fallen.accept_append: Mourning spirits gather round him. Lay those to rest first.

cb_cobrahn_and_kresh.accept_append: Deviate shamblers hold the ring between them.

cb_thunder_and_slumber.accept_append: Deviate ravagers run the galleries between the two.

sub_accept: then the horned one - the herders call him Hollowhorn.
